info.title: SketchForge REST API v1 (contracted subset)
info.description: Generated from the runtime-facing API operation registry. This document contains only operations whose request, query, and response metadata can be represented accurately. See x-sketchforge-omitted-operations for the registered operations that still need contract work.

index.description: Zero-based index used by shell requests.

id.description: Application-owned face ID; use it as the faceColors key in PATCH /api/v1/shapes.

surfaceType.description: Surface kind reported by the CAD kernel, or unknown when unavailable.

404.description: Resource not found or API disabled.

422.description: Request is valid JSON but cannot be applied.

get.description: Lists each face with its shell-request index and stable application-owned ID. Face IDs can be used as faceColors keys in PATCH /api/v1/shapes.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Whitespace is trimmed before validation. ID starts with a letter or digit and contains only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

parameters.name: shapeId
parameters.description: Whitespace is trimmed; the remaining value must not be empty.
